subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh or replace the open conflicting fork PR that references this issue, or close that path and permit a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible on current main, but the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr with an open closing-syntax fork PR, so automation should not start another repair until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused fix covering both custom-prompt mutation and transcript-marker model visibility.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real proof, and expand tests if the transcript-marker boundary remains in scope.

options.title: Pause For Maintainer Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new repair until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused fix covering both custom-prompt mutation and transcript-marker model visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to both the original path-hint commit and the first maintainer fix attempt for this regression.
